text:
anna-sales: FYI we just got a new set of asks from North Harbor for the enterprise POC. Main asks: SSO (SAML + OIDC), SCIM provisioning (bulk + deltas), RBAC mapping to groups, and domain proofing.

ben-se: timeline?

anna-sales: POC next Tue -> they want preflight checklist + a clear pricing note for dedicated capacity if provisioning rate > 2k users/day.

ben-se: SCIM rate limits: we can support burst imports but need to confirm delta window and backoff behaviour. I'll ping infra.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: SCIM service currently set to 20 req/s per tenant; can be increased via ticket.

carlos-security: couple security/legal flags I need answered before we sign off:
- Where are the SCIM payloads stored at rest?
- Is SCIM traffic TLS mutual auth supported?
- Session duration and SAML assertion retention policy?

anna-sales: Diana from legal is on the thread for data residency questions.

diana-legal: We need explicit answers for data locality (EU vs US), logs retention (for audit), and whether any PII flows to third-party analytics. Also a copy of the SAML cert rotation policy.

ben-se: Technical answers:
- SCIM payloads are processed in-region for Private and Dedicated; hosted API may cross regions unless customer pins region.
- At-rest: user provisioning payloads are encrypted with customer-specific KMS keys for Private/Dedicated; hosted uses platform-managed KMS.
- mTLS: we currently support bearer token + TLS; mTLS for SCIM is on the roadmap, enterprise customers can request an enablement ticket.

ben-se: SAML details: ACS and EntityID configurable. We support both SHA256 and SHA1 signing (we recommend SHA256). Certificate rotation is zero-downtime with overlap window; rotation docs here: https://redwood.example/rotation

anna-sales: Customer also wants delegated admin model (ability to create org-admins via SCIM) and RBAC mapping: groups -> roles mapping with optional attribute mapping. Are there known gaps?

ben-se: We support group->role mapping via SCIM group membership and custom attribute mapping. Delegated admin creation via SCIM requires an extra entitlement and approval (security). We'll need to confirm rate limits and audit events for admin-creation.

carlos-security: Add audit logging requirement to the contract: admin creation/modification events must be logged and retained 1 year (customer requirement). Also need assurance that SCIM PATCH operations can be restricted to certain attributes (no arbitrary role escalation).

diana-legal: Can we provide a short statement on regulatory compliance (SOC2 + ISO) and whether logs can be sent to customer SIEM (syslog/HTTP) for the POC?

anna-sales: They asked about how domain ownership is proven — they prefer DNS TXT claim over email-based verification. Any blockers?

ben-se: DNS TXT verification supported. We provide the TXT value via the console and it must be present at the tenant domain's zone. We can automate periodic checks and revalidate TTLs. Edge case: nested tenants with vanity domains — will need DNS delegation notes.

alex-ps: Pricing callout: if they request Dedicated with guaranteed throughput for heavy SCIM imports + canary traffic routing, we should align on a monthly commit. For a POC, propose a short-term Dedicated eval credit and surcharge for high sync rates. I'll draft numbers.

anna-sales: Action items: 
- ben-se: confirm SCIM delta window, PATCH attribute restriction options, and mTLS ETA (by EOD).
- carlos-security: prepare a short security FAQ covering KMS, logs retention, and audit events (tomorrow).
- diana-legal: draft the privacy/data residency clause and requested contract language for admin audit (48h).
- alex-ps: draft a Dedicated POC quote + optional surge pricing (24h).

ben-se: noted. I'll also attach a sample SCIM PATCH snippet they can run in POC:

PATCH /scim/v2/Users/2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "name.givenName", "value": "Sam"}
  ]
}

anna-sales: Perfect. I'll loop in the customer's SRE and legal on Slack and schedule a sync. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

carlos-security: If they push for mTLS immediately, escalate to Eng-Platform; otherwise the KMS + audit controls should be acceptable for most banks.

anna-sales: Closing note: goal is to have preflight checklist + one-pager on constraints and quote before Monday's call.

alex-ps: I'll post the draft quote here when ready.

anna-sales: thanks all.
